subject: Park Operating Hours and Lighting Policy
overview: The Medford Park Commission approved field permit policy revisions, maintained pool and pond fees, and established operating hours and lighting schedules across several city parks.

items.title: Dugger Park Equipment Storage Box Request
items.summary: The commission approved a request from Metro Recreation tennis coach Drew Henderson to install an equipment storage bin at Dugger Park.

items.title: Field Permit Application Procedures and Payment Rules
items.summary: The commission agreed to updated permit guidelines requiring full upfront payment for single-day events, a 50 percent deposit for seasonal users, and an explicit prohibition on bounce houses.

items.title: Tufts Pool and Wrights Pond Fees and Rules
items.summary: The commission approved maintaining 2025 membership fees, rental rates, and operating policies for Tufts Pool and Wrights Pond into 2026.

items.title: 2026 Park Commission Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The commission reviewed its meeting schedule for 2026 while noting potential quorum challenges during school vacation weeks.

items.title: Park Operating Hours and Lighting Schedules
items.summary: Following public input, the commission voted to restore basketball court lighting at Hickey Park and established updated operating hours and light cutoffs for facilities at Carr Park and Playstead Park.

items.title: Hickey Park Little Free Library Proposal
items.summary: The commission tabled a proposal for a Little Free Library at Hickey Park until February to receive detailed design plans.
